summary: Legend cards are the academy telling stories about you, and each turns on what you do with the story; the fall is handled with warmth rather than punishment. Two small continuity fixes, both made.

issues.problem: Recognising 'the blue thread on their wrist' gates on seen(spot_fan_charm), but the blue-thread fad only happens if you wore the charm.
"You were busy being a legend": the fall only needs you to have been Famous.
